title: MasterFormDialog (reusable dialog)
scope: Wrapper around shadcn Dialog. Props: open, onOpenChange, title, children, onSubmit, isSubmitting. Footer has Cancel (calls onOpenChange(false)) and Save (calls onSubmit; disabled while isSubmitting).

success_criteria.manual: Save button calls onSubmit; Cancel closes dialog.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Dialog wraps children form; Save disabled while isSubmitting.
